name: Baba Mitsunari
source: An infamous master thief, his policy of stealing only from crooks has attracted him quite a following. He gave Eisuke the idea of holding the auction so he would have a place to sell his stolen goods.
translation: An infamous master thief, his policy of stealing only from crooks has attracted him quite a following. He gave Eisuke the idea of holding the auction so he would have a place to sell his stolen goods.
